outputs.explanation: Panel A consists of flow cytometry scatter/dot plots (pseudocolor density plots) showing individual events directly; these are not bar charts of averages and are exempt as scatter-type plots.
Panel B shows flow cytometry scatter plots displaying individual cell events, not summary/average statistics, so individual data points are inherently present and no overlay is needed.
Panel C shows flow cytometry gating scatter plots depicting individual events; these are exempt scatter-type plots, not bar charts of averaged data.
Panel D is a color-coded overlay of scatter plots (MBC, GC, naive populations) showing individual cell events, not an averaged summary statistic requiring point overlay.
Panel E shows flow cytometry gating scatter plots with individual cell events plotted directly; exempt as scatter-type plots, no averages are depicted.
